summary: The API-surface generator resolves the template package pins and validates taught/waived public members, but copies each manifest header verbatim. A dependency version can change while its signatures remain identical, so successful generation/check alone does not refresh the authored Mirrored-from version. Update the corresponding manifest headers and regenerate; do not hand-edit emitted signatures or blanket-waive new public members. Candidate consumer qualification uses the canonical product-local-feed action, which packs the template UI pin with restore enabled so internal project-to-package dependencies share that version. Source development keeps its distinct local-pack sentinel. Packing the exact candidate in a separate checkout preserves the already-qualified source checkout locks and assets. These are source/qualification boundaries; they establish neither publication nor licensed, display, or bare-metal runtime acceptance.
title: Dependency updates must reconcile authored mirror headers and isolate pack-version assets
